spec_match.rationale: CSS Borders 4 defines six keywords plus superellipse(). All six keywords and superellipse(2) parse in the provided Chrome 152; square computes to superellipse(infinity), and squircle matches superellipse(2).

interactive.rationale: Chrome DevTools MCP drove the radius slider through 28, 0, 80, 79 and 0 at both viewports; all seven boxes and the live readout update.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index and gallery now promise six keywords and one functional example, explicitly identifying the squircle alias rather than claiming seven distinct silhouettes or every possible function value.

edge_cases.rationale: Native radius-zero rendering is square for all seven examples. Explicitly simulated CSS.supports absence and partial support produce honest 0/7 and 5/7 counts and border-radius fallbacks at both sizes; these are diagnostics, not old-engine tests.

references.rationale: ChromeStatus and CSS Borders 4 links remain; the current CSSWG value grammar and keyword/function equivalences were checked directly.

conformance.rationale: The immutable feature suite tests separate corner shorthands and still reports 1 pass / 7 fail in this MCP configuration. Gallery vocabulary is covered by a new source regression check and native MCP parsing/rendering checks, without changing those assertions.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Fresh Chrome DevTools MCP checks at 1280x800 DPR1 and 360x740 DPR3 mobile/touch recorded native values, computed shapes, slider changes, screenshots and clean console snapshots. See reports/8vh-astra-20260924/.

telemetry_health.rationale: The existing gallery-rendered client assertion now uses the actual supported count and array length. Requests were captured; backend event storage was not audited in this fix.

design_system.rationale: Existing design tokens and state styles are retained, including the shared high-contrast support notice. No new raw colors or custom controls.

accessibility.rationale: Natural Tab navigation reaches the labelled native slider; Home and ArrowRight update its value, visible focus and polite live output. The slider is at least 44px high and each example retains a text support state.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: All tested native radius states and simulated fallback states have matching document/client widths at 360px and 1280px. This is emulated desktop/mobile coverage, not physical-device or full assistive-technology certification.

guidanceConsulted.query: corner-shape square squircle superellipse valid CSS values border radius progressive enhancement accessible range slider
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use corner-shape as progressive enhancement over ordinary border-radius (section 8, Shapes).
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Retained per-value feature detection and border-radius fallback; replaced the invalid keyword with spec vocabulary and made the equivalent functional example explicit.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: reports/8vh-astra-20260924/README.md; canonical modern-web-guidance@latest retrieval, with the template update warning recorded.

summary: 8vh replaces the invalid straight example with square, adds superellipse(2), and makes counts and copy reflect seven example values, not seven unique shapes. Native and simulated-fallback MCP checks pass at both viewport presets. Separate corner-shorthand assertion failures remain visible and unchanged. Independent review is required before publication.
